name: Number Line Rocket
description: Tap a spot on the number line and the rocket flies there, from 0 to 10 up to 0 to 1000, then fractions and negatives.

about.concept: Magnitude and position. Numbers live at places on a line; tapping where 37 should be, and seeing the rocket land, builds an internal sense of distance between numbers.
about.progression: The line runs 0 to 10, then 0 to 20, 100 and 1000, then unlabeled lines where position must be estimated, then fractions between whole numbers and negative numbers left of zero.
